title: 86% Chance Trump Blinks on Tariffs, But Bitcoin Will Tell You First
text: President Donald Trump’s February 1 tariff deadline for eight European nations tied to Greenland has sparked a familiar trader fear: markets may shake out positions before suddenly reversing.ChatGPT’s historical pattern analysis of comparable Trump tariff episodes suggests an 86% likelihood of some off-ramp (a pause, delay, exemption, or walkback) either ...
